method: Real 1-drop XRP payment to a second address we also control (XRPL forbids sender == destination, so no self-pay), timed submit -> validated ledger via xrpl-py submit_and_wait. A validated ledger is XRPL's true, deterministic finality (no reorgs, no soft-vs-hard split). Sent sequentially, one validated before the next (also required by the account Sequence number). NOTE: native XRP, not USDC like the other rails; this is the pure native-asset settlement number.
